dataset: SOFR (Secured Overnight Financing Rate), overnight fixing
publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, via FRED (St. Louis Fed)
licence: FRED terms of use; SOFR is published by the New York Fed under its own terms of use for reference rates.
notes: Overnight fixing only. Not a term structure and not an input to any curve in this repository.
No free redistributable USD SOFR swap curve exists; the FRED ICE Swap Rate series return 404 and CME Term SOFR is licensed.
